description: Defines the ModelScreenCondition class which models the <condition> element in a widget screen schema. Contains inner classes for specific condition types, notably IfEmptySection, and a factory class for creating condition instances.

classes.name: ModelScreenCondition
classes.description: Models the <condition> element in a widget screen. Designed to be immutable and thread-safe. Contains nested classes for specific condition types and a factory.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor that implements ModelConditionVisitor.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition against a given context map.

methods.name: getSectionExdr
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander for the section name.
